messages:
marina: uploaded a compact prototype for a contextual "badge toggle" inside the model catalog. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc
main question: when a version is pinned, should the row badge show catalog metrics or the pinned-version metrics by default?
kevin: i vote pinned metrics by default. if i explicitly pinned v2.0, i expect that row to show v2.0 stats. otherwise it's surprising. :+1:
ajay: pinned-by-default makes sense, but what about discoverability for other users? maybe a tiny chevron that opens a two-option menu: Catalog / Pinned. quick toggle.
rachel: ux nits: the chevron needs clear labeling. suggest aria-label: "Switch badge metric: catalog or pinned version". also the yellow badge variant fails contrast at small sizes. claire?
claire_a11y: yep. need at least 4.5:1 for normal text. options: darker text on the yellow token or increase background darkness. the chevron must be keyboard-focusable and use aria-pressed or a proper menu pattern.
sam_frontend: note on implementation: badges are reused in the catalog list and the compare drawer; adding per-row popovers will affect virtualization and increase memory. prefer storing a per-route override in state instead of per-row DOM state. a global header toggle could be cheaper.
marina: tradeoff: global toggle is discoverable, row-level toggle is contextual. telemetry? pablo any numbers on how many people pin?
pablo: telemetry: pinned versions active in ~19% of catalog sessions. but only ~5% of compare starts include a metric switch. small but notable cohort. suggest progressive disclosure: default to catalog metrics, and when user pins, show a subtle inline hint "Pinned version active  Show pinned metrics".
kevin: i like progressive hint. microcopy: visually keep compact "p95: 120ms" but use aria-label "P95 latency for Model X (pinned v2.0)  120 milliseconds" for screen readers.
claire_a11y: yes. also use aria-live polite when the value updates after toggling view. ensure focus management: if the popover opens, trap arrow key nav inside.
ajay: multi-pin edge case: if users pin multiple rows then open compare, should the badges reflect each row's pinned version individually? that could be messy.
marina: proposed flow: 1) default badges show catalog metrics. 2) when a single row is pinned via row actions, show inline hint on that row offering "View pinned metrics". 3) toggling persists for the session only (route state). 4) multi-select/pin opens a modal compare where metrics shown are always pinned-per-row (dense view).
sam_frontend: that approach reduces per-row DOM state. implementation tasks: portal popover for the hint, session-level route state for overrides, aria attributes, keyboard handlers. estimate: 2 dev days + 1 a11y review.
rachel: updated figma includes darker badge tokens and hint copy. i added CSS token suggestion: --badge-text-on-warning: #2b2b2b.
pablo: logging request: add events for hint shown, hint accepted, and toggle switch. helps track adoption and tweak placement.
ui-bot: deploybot: visual regression snapshot created for branch badge-context-toggle. link: https://ci.internal/snapshots/7890
contains 2 diffs: focus ring, badge color.
marina: ok if product/design/eng/a11y give thumbs i'll move to PR. please respond with quick approvals or callouts.
kevin: :+1:
claire_a11y: :+1: with the aria-live/focus details
sam_frontend: :+1: will pick up after sprint planning
ajay: one small ask: keep hint tooltip copy < 100 chars.
marina: noted. will post updated figma + checklist when ready. thanks everyone!
